overview.Name: Spark I Acquisition Corporation
overview.Description: Spark I Acquisition Corporation does not have significant operations. The company focuses on effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. It intends to target late-stage technology startups in Asia or U.S. technology companies with a strong Asia presence or strategy. Spark I Acquisition Corporation was incorporated in 2021 and is based in Palo Alto, California.
